tools.name: get_mtd_deadlines
tools.description:
Returns the four MTD for Income Tax quarterly update periods for a tax year (standard and calendar period ends), each deadline, the final declaration date, and days until the next deadline. Works without signing in.
Use this when: someone asks when the next quarterly update is due or what a Quarter

tools.name: get_started
tools.description:
Returns the practice's setup and current position: plan and active Clients vs limit, Clients, open Chases per Quarter, settings still unset, and the next few things the practitioner can say.
Use this when: the practitioner asks where they're up to or what to do next.

tools.name: export_practice_data
tools.description:
Exports everything the practice holds in MTD Chase (Clients, Chases with history, Nudges sent, Records list, requests) as one JSON file; returns a download link for the signed-in practitioner.
Use this when: they want a copy of their data or are leaving.

tools.name: request_feature
tools.description:
Files a request with MTD Chase when the user asks for something none of the other tools can do, or adds a vote to a matching open request; returns its ID, status and any workaround with existing tools. No date is promised.
Use this when: the practitioner wants a capability MTD Chase doesn't have.

tools.name: list_my_requests
tools.description:
Lists the practice's feature requests with status (open, planned, live, declined), how many times each was asked for, the workaround meanwhile, and for declined ones the reason.
Use this when: asked what happened to something they asked for.
Not for: asking for something new (request_feature) or wha

tools.name: whats_new
tools.description:
Lists changes that went live recently in MTD Chase, and which of this practice's requests are now live, with the date each went live and what to say to try it.
Use this when: the practitioner asks what's new, or whether something they asked for is live yet.

tools.name: add_clients
tools.description:
Adds Clients (people the practice does MTD quarterly updates for) from a pasted list; matches existing Clients by email, else exact name. confirm:false (default) shows what would be added, skipped as duplicates, or rejected, and the plan-limit effect; confirm:true saves. Max 500.

tools.name: update_client
tools.description:
Changes one Client's name, email, mobile, period type (standard/calendar), tags or reference. Returns before → after.
Use this when: a Client's details change.
Not for: stopping chasing someone (archive_client) or pausing nudges (pause_nudges).

tools.name: archive_client
tools.description:
Archives a Client who has left: their open Chases become skipped and their links stop working; they stop counting towards the plan limit. confirm:false (default) shows what would change. unarchive:true brings them back.
Use this when: a Client leaves the practice or comes back.

tools.name: list_clients
tools.description:
Lists Clients with contact details, period type, tags and the status of their Chase for the current Quarter.
Use this when: looking up who the practice has, finding a Client's details, or seeing a tagged group (e.g. landlords) with this Quarter's status.

tools.name: start_chase
tools.description: Starts chasing Clients for their records for a Quarter: each gets a personal link (no login, works on a phone) and a first email; then Nudges go out on the practice's plan until they send their records. confirm:false (default) shows who would be chased, who has no email, the checklist and the dates

tools.name: get_chase_links
tools.description:
Returns each Client's personal records link for a Quarter and a ready-to-paste message for a messaging app or text.
Use this when: the practitioner wants to send a link themselves (no email on file, or they prefer a messaging app or text).

tools.name: mark_chase
tools.description:
Sets one Client's Chase for a Quarter to ready, partial, nothing_to_report, skipped or back to waiting, with an optional note; Nudges stop for ready/nothing_to_report/skipped and resume for waiting/partial. The change is recorded in the Client's history.

tools.name: list_records
tools.description:
Lists the files (name, size, received) a Client sent through their link for a Quarter — or for every Client in a Quarter — with download links valid 24 hours for the signed-in practitioner, and the Client's note marked as written by the Client.
Use this when: asked what a Client sent or to download

tools.name: set_nudge_plan
tools.description: Sets when Nudges (reminder emails) go out for every Chase, including ones already running, counted from the date Clients are asked to send by (the ask-by date): days before it, on the day, and days after it, sent at 09:00 UK time on weekdays. A value left out keeps its current setting. Returns the p

tools.name: send_nudges_now
tools.description:
Sends a Nudge email now to Clients who haven't finished sending records for a Quarter (waiting or partial), at most one per Client per day. confirm:false (default) lists who would get one and who is excluded (no email, nudged today, paused); confirm:true sends.
Use this when: chasing up everyone out

tools.name: pause_nudges
tools.description:
Stops all Nudges to one Client until a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or until resumed; resume:true restarts them. The result warns if the pause runs past a deadline.
Use this when: a Client is ill, away or has asked for no reminders for now.
Not for: a Client who has left (archive_client) or has sent their reco

tools.description:
Returns the Clients who haven't finished sending records for a Quarter (waiting or partial), with days to/after the date they were asked to send by, last Nudge, whether they opened their link, and counts per status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: add_clients, get_chase_links, send_nudges_now · Private data: get_mtd_deadlines, update_practice, export_practice_data, request_feature, list_clients, start_chase, get_chase_links, mark_chase, list_records, send_nudges_now, pause_nudges, whos_outstanding, get_client_history · Public sink: update_practice, add_clients, update_client, start_chase, get_chase_links, mark_chase, set_nudge_plan, send_nudges_now, whos_outstanding, get_client_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: add_clients, get_chase_links, send_nudges_now · Private data: get_mtd_deadlines, update_practice, export_practice_data, request_feature, list_clients, start_chase, get_chase_links, mark_chase, list_records, send_nudges_now, pause_nudges, whos_outstanding, get_client_history · Public sink: update_practice, add_clients, update_client, start_chase, get_chase_links, mark_chase, set_nudge_plan, send_nudges_now, whos_outstanding, get_client_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
